DECLARATION OF NON SERVICE
(Small Claims)

FOR COURT USE ONLY

SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
STREET ADDRESS: 42011 4th Street West
MAILING ADDRESS: 42011 4th Street West
CITY AND ZIP CODE: Lancaster 93534
BRANCH NAME: N. Dist. Michael Antonovich Antelope Vly. Crthse

PLAINTIFF/PETITIONER: Nicolas Hernandez
CASE NUMBER: 26AVSC00192
DEFENDANT/RESPONDENT: Local Health Council of Los Angeles County

DECLARATION OF NON SERVICE
Ref. No. or File No.: REF-24858130

I declare that I am and was on the dates herein mentioned, over the age of 18 years, not a party to nor interested in the above entitled action, and competent to be a witness therein.

I received the following documents for service:
Plaintiff's Claim And Order To Go To Small Claims Court

I attempted to serve Local Health Council of Los Angeles County (dba L.A. Care Health Plan)
at the address of 1055 W 7th St Fl 10, Los Angeles, CA 90017

and was unable to effect service for the following reasons:
3/22/2026 12:29 PM: I was unable to access the address due to secured building although I waited. Unable to enter due to locked doors as well as entire building seems to be under construction and all tagged up around, also upon checking the company online it showed that they have moved from this location back in 2024 and they should be at 1200 w 7th st, that is what online showed, per my conversation at a different attempt at this location by security i was advised building is under construction as many of the floors are being converted into residential and majority of business have moved out and mainly its vacant
3/23/2026 11:24 AM: The property appeared vacant which was supported by on-site worker and property manager. This building is under construction floor 10 is vacant per my conversation with onsite worker and manager as well as workers doing construction at building they have stated company has moved out entirely from this address back in 2025 and they are located at 1200 w 7th st now

Fee for service: $ 76.00

I am a registered California process server; my name, address, phone number, and county of registration and number are:

Hovhannes Kadamyan For: ABC Legal Services, LLC
358 W MILFORD ST UNIT 106, GLENDALE, CA 91203 Registration #: 6779
818-203-9990 County: Los Angeles
Los Angeles county clerk, #2025024911

I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California the foregoing is true and correct.
Date: 03/23/2026

(Signature of Hovhannes Kadamyan)
Hovhannes Kadamyan (PRINTED NAME OF DECLARANT) (SIGNATURE OF DECLARANT)
